messages:
anna-ux: heads-up — p95 on /v1/generate spiked ~09:22 in us-west-2. p50 looks fine. screenshot: https://redwood.internal/snap/abc123 :thinking:
mike-platform: which dashboard view? endpoint-level or region rollup?
anna-ux: endpoint-level > endpoint=/v1/generate > p50/p95/p99. The spike is isolated to p95+p99, lasted ~3 minutes.
sam-telemetry: I pulled raw events — sample_count drops right before the jump (see below). Looks like rate-limiter fired and requests were rerouted.
sam-telemetry: ```json
{"minute": "2023-08-25T09:21:00Z", "samples": 420, "p95": 120}
{"minute": "2023-08-25T09:22:00Z", "samples": 7,   "p95": 890}
{"minute": "2023-08-25T09:23:00Z", "samples": 3,   "p95": 1500}
```
dez-sre: we also saw rate-limiter logs at 09:21:58 redirecting 40% of traffic to the slow-fallback pool. fallback model has heavier tail.
lina-eng: console currently aggregates 60s rollups and merges tdigests across shards. If a minute has very few samples we still merge, which can blow up higher quantiles when weight shifts mid-window.
mike-platform: so two effects: (1) lower sample counts cause percentile instability, (2) routing weight shift introduces a different latency distribution. Combined -> p95 jump.
anna-ux: proposal: annotate the chart when sample_count < 10 and show a low-sample badge. Also in backend, treat buckets with sample_count < N as "sparse" and avoid naive merge that interpolates quantiles.
sam-telemetry: agreed. Suggested rollout plan:
 - pipeline: change rollup behavior: if sample_count < 5 then emit an empty_bucket marker (do not merge tdigest).
 - console: display sample_count and show a tooltip "low sample — percentiles unreliable".
 - routing: add an event tag to metric that records "route-weight-change=true" when fallback kicks in so dashboard can break down by route.
lina-eng: quick query tweak we can deploy as a hotfix: add `min_sample_count` param to the dashboard query. Example:
```yaml
agg.window: 60s
query.params: {min_sample_count: 5, propagate_empty: true}
```
mike-platform: long-term we should also store per-route tdigest and expose layered percentiles (global vs route-specific) so shifts are visible.
dez-sre: can we reproduce? I can run a synthetic with a sudden 40% reroute to fallback for 2 min and capture dashboards.
anna-ux: please do. If reproducible we'll open a small RFC for the pipeline change + console UX.
deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: telemetry-pipeline v2.1 -> canary group=metrics-canary at 2023-08-25T15:30:00Z (will post status).
sam-telemetry: FYI, one nuance — downstream consumers expect tdigest merges for continuity (alerts depend on p95). So we need a safety path: when skipping merges, emit a synthetic "sparse" datapoint that alerts can opt out of.
anna-ux: good point. Add an alert-exclusion flag on sparse datapoints.
mike-platform: TL;DR action list: 1) dez -> reproduce with synthetic; 2) sam -> prototype min_sample_count switch + sparse marker; 3) lina -> console badge and tooltip; 4) anna -> add docs + update alerts to ignore sparse markers.
anna-ux: pinging @mike-platform @sam-telemetry @lina-eng to confirm owns. :thumbsup:
mike-platform: I'll own the RFC and API change.
sam-telemetry: I'll own pipeline change.
lina-eng: I'll do the console UX and chart annotation.
dez-sre: running repro now, will report in this thread.
anna-ux: thanks — let's aim for canary next week if repro is clean.
(reaction: :eyes: on dez-sre's repro comment)
